scope:
Fixed-S general batches and odd native-orphan fallback: qualification + cost.

Captured subsets use real AR Q/KV at the captured step, not future survivor Q.
Extra-tail runs explicitly append synthetic KV for growth stress only.
layout: native original physical IDs and stride
limitations: Fixed graph per batch size, explicit setup/capture; no unlimited topology reuse.
B<4 is a native fallback, not a speedup.
Odd orphan uses one extra native kernel at original S; its full cost is included.
Subset Q is the original AR snapshot; appended-tail stress is synthetic and not natural output.
